annotations.title: ENS name to address and address to ENS name

description: Resolve an Ethereum Name Service name such as vitalik.eth to its wallet address and avatar, or look up the primary ENS name of an address (reverse resolution). Read live from Ethereum mainnet. Use to turn a human-readable name into a payable address, or to show a readable name for a counterparty address. Example: name=vitalik.eth. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only; not marked read-only because each call is charged.
